_comment: VENDORED type vocabulary. The canonical standard at Data-Flow-Advisory/orchestrator@feat/drift-gate (CONNECTORS.md + types.json) is unreachable to the fleet token (HTTP 404), so this organ vendors the JSON-primitive vocabulary to keep the conformance check self-contained. Type NAMES must be reconciled with the canonical orchestrator types.json once it is readable.

number.desc: int or float; may be null where the source coerces a non-number to None

object.desc: JSON object / dict; may be null where the source treats absence as fail-open
